- [Pushes and zooms](pushes-and-zooms.md): Read when the user says zoom in, closer, dizzy or a punch of a zoom. Holds: Push-in (dolly in) (`push_in`); Crash zoom (snap zoom) (`crash_zoom`); Slow zoom-in (`slow_zoom`); Dolly zoom (vertigo effect) (`dolly_zoom`).
- [Travelling and pulling away](travel-and-pull-back.md): Read when the camera goes with the subject, goes away from it, or runs without a cut. Holds: Tracking shot (lateral dolly) (`tracking_side`); Follow shot (from behind) (`follow_behind`); Long take (oner) (`oner`); Pull-back (dolly out) (`pull_back`).
- [Height, scale and reveal](height-and-reveal.md): Read when the user wants scale, a view from above, a reveal or a calm composed frame.
